info.name: OMS - Order Management System (Phases 0-3)
info.description:
user-service (:8081), product-service (:8082), order-service (:8083).

**How to run:** import both files, select "OMS Local" environment, run `1. Auth > Login (admin)` first — it stores `accessToken`. Then run the whole collection top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner. The order of folders matters: auth tokens and IDs flow forward.

**order-service must be running on :8083** before executing folder 6.
